title: WHAT IF YOU COULD SELL YOUR MEMORIES? 🧠💰 (The $50M Mistake) #Shorts
description:
What if you could sell your memories for millions of dollars? 🧠💸
Pip found a secret biotech lab that buys memories: $200,000 for high school, $1,000,000 for his first heartbreak. Soon, Pip was living in a $30 Million penthouse with supercars!

But one morning, he found a picture of his mother and realized he had sold her memory for a yacht! He had all the money in the world, but couldn't remember who he was. Now the lab offers $50,000,000 for his core soul and identity...

═══════════════════════════════════════════
💬 WHAT WOULD YOU DO?
👉 Option A: "BUY BACK YOUR SOUL! (Live broke, but keep your memories & mother)"
👉 Option B: "TAKE THE $50 MILLION! (Erase your past & live as a blank billionaire)"

Drop your choice in the comments below! 👇
